biotools.summary: This resource provides Shiny R web apps designed to assist researchers in determining appropriate sample sizes for clinical trials, focusing on two-arm binary outcome trials and multi-arm normally distributed outcome trials. The apps facilitate understanding of statistical power and precision in estimating treatment effects.
